title: Partner Account Manager - France
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste

Ce poste de direction est essentiel : il consiste à construire et à faire passer à l’échelle les partenariats d’Anthropic avec les cabinets de conseil, les intégrateurs de systèmes mondiaux (GSI) et les boutiques partenaires nativement IA en France.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe commerciale pour que les clients adoptent l’IA grâce à nos partenaires.

Ce poste est un poste de construction, et non de gestion. Compte tenu du stade de développement d’Anthropic, nous recherchons un profil qui a déjà fait ses preuves en faisant passer des partenariats de zéro à des moteurs de revenus à grande échelle, un profil qui a bâti ces relations de A à Z, et non simplement hérité de relations existantes pour les gérer.

Responsabilités

  • Partenariats et exécution
    • Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l’équipe commerciale pour comprendre comment les partenaires peuvent soutenir l’adoption de Claude par les clients.
    • Vous accompagnerez les partenaires dans la création de solutions clients reproductibles, répondant à des cas d’usage précis dans de nombreux secteurs : services financiers, santé, distribution, industrie, secteur public et services professionnels.
  • Performance et pilotage des indicateurs clés (KPI)
    • Vous portez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance et vous les pilotez : revenus influencés par les partenaires, livraison réalisée par les partenaires, nombre de personnes consultantes formées et certifiées.
    • Chaque deal influencé par votre portefeuille de partenaires doit être conçu pour la réussite du client et la croissance de sa valeur à long terme. Vous définirez des critères de réussite pour les comptes communs, veillerez à la qualité de la mise en œuvre et de l’accompagnement à l’adoption, et mettrez en place des boucles de retour d’expérience favorisant l’amélioration continue.
    • Vous rendrez compte de la santé des partenariats, de leur avancement et de leurs résultats commerciaux, en vous appuyant sur des analyses fondées sur les données.
  • Développement du marché et construction de la marque
    • Vous renforcerez la notoriété de la marque Anthropic en France grâce à des relations stratégiques avec les partenaires.
    • Vous élaborerez et déploierez des stratégies de mise sur le marché (GTM) propres à chaque marché, adaptées aux pratiques commerciales et aux nuances culturelles locales.
    • Vous composerez avec les enjeux locaux de réglementation, de conformité et de souveraineté des données.
    • Vous créerez un avantage concurrentiel grâce aux capacités singulières des partenaires et à des propositions de valeur élaborées en commun.

Votre profil

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si vous réunissez les atouts suivants :

  • Vous avez l’esprit d’initiative et le goût de construire : vous êtes à l’aise pour partir de zéro et créer des partenariats d’envergure.
  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français.
  • Vous comptez au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats technologiques à destination des entreprises, idéalement dans le cloud, l’IA/ML ou les activités de plateforme.
  • Vous avez une culture de la donnée, tournée vers les résultats mesurables et l’atteinte des KPI, et un historique avéré de revenus additionnels générés grâce aux partenariats dans la région.
  • Vous avez démontré votre capacité à assurer la réussite des clients et la protection de la marque via les canaux partenaires.
  • Vous avez l’esprit de compétition : la victoire et la différenciation sont votre moteur.
  • Vous avez une approche collaborative et savez travailler de façon transversale avec les équipes commerciales, produit, marketing et régionales.
  • Vous nourrissez une vraie passion pour l’IA et vous vous reconnaissez dans la mission d’Anthropic : développer une IA bénéfique.

Relations de travail

Votre rattachement hiérarchique se fera auprès de la direction des partenariats internationaux, tandis que votre activité quotidienne sera pilotée par la personne responsable des partenariats EMEA Sud. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la direction commerciale régionale d’Anthropic et ses Account Executives, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Customer Success et Applied AI de la région.

Lieu et déplacements

Ce poste est basé à Paris, en France, avec des déplacements à prévoir pour rencontrer les partenaires et les clients.

About the Role

This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and scaling Anthropic's consulting, GSIs and AI-native boutique partners in France.
You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure customers are adopting AI through our partners.


This is a builder role, not a manager role. Given Anthropic's stage, we need someone who has proven they can take partnerships from zero to scaled revenue engines — someone who has built these relationships from the ground up, not just inherited and managed existing ones.

Responsibilities:

  • Partnerships and execution:
    • You will engage closely with the sales team to understand how partners can support customer Claude adoption
    • You will guide partners in creating repeatable customer solutions that address specific use cases across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, public sector, and professional services.
  • Performance and KPI ownership:
    • Own and drive key performance indicators, partner-influenced revenue, partner delivery, consultants trained and certified
    • Every deal influenced through your partner portfolio must be architected for customer success and long-term value expansion. You will establish success criteria for joint accounts, ensure proper implementation and adoption support, and create feedback loops that drive continuous improvement.
    • Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights
  • Market Development & Brand Building
    • Amplify the Anthropic brand in France strategic partner relationships
    • Develop and execute market-specific GTM strategies adapted to local business practices and cultural nuances
    • Navigate local regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty considerations
    • Create competitive differentiation through unique partner capabilities and joint value propositions

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Builder mentality — comfortable starting from zero and creating scaled partnerships

Fluent in English and French

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology partnerships, ideally within cloud, AI/ML, or platform businesses
  • Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment. Track record of driving incremental revenues through partnerships in the region
  • History of delivering exceptional customer success and brand protection through partner channels
  • Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation
  • Collaborative approach with ability to work cross-functionally across sales, product, marketing, and regional teams
  • Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

Working Relationships

You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our South EMEA Partnerships lead. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Applied AI teams.

Location and Travel

This role will be based in Paris, France with travel expected to engage with partners and customers externally.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
€220.000—€260.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Account Executive 4
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive 4 on our High Tech team!

About the job

This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling and closing new business opportunities across our Messaging, Voice and Email products. In this role, you will be directly responsible for expanding our messaging business with some of the largest and fastest growing mid-market and enterprise companies in the High Tech vertical. New Business Account Executives are experts in the CPaaS ecosystem and Twilio’s product offerings. This role is highly cross functional, with deep integration with product management, carrier relations, finance, and solutions engineering teams.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Drive new customer acquisition, while being assigned a quota for iACV (incremental Account Contract Value)

title: Business Development Manager, Product Partnerships
description:
About the Team

We are hiring a Product Partnerships Manager based in Germany with primary responsibility for Germany. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships in the German market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will identify and manage relationships with strategic product partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for Germany, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note that this role is based out of our Munich office, with 3 days a week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product partnership strategy and execution for Germany, driving end-to-end partnership sourcing and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities.

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Over time, lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of Germany and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond Germany or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in product partnerships or partnership business development within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of the German market, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Technical Account Manager (APJ)
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be the primary technical partner for our Team & customers after the sale, helping them adopt, operate, and get long-term value from Supabase.

At Supabase, TAMs are the technical owners of their assigned accounts, working closely with our most valuable customers to:

  • Understand each customer’s architecture, use cases, constraints, and goals.

  • Validate deployments and guide customers through onboarding and early success.

  • Proactively surface risks and optimization opportunities before they become incidents.

  • Coordinate internal teams on complex escalations and drive root cause analysis.

  • Align Supabase capabilities with the customer’s roadmap.

Successful TAMs are proactive, technically credible, and customer-first. TAM is a relationship, not a response channel: you’ll act as an extension of your customers’ teams and advocate on their behalf within Supabase.

You’ll be joining our Success team, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility:

Technical Ownership & Onboarding

Act as the technical owner for your assigned accounts, documenting environments, mapping dependencies, and tracking technical risks.

Validate architecture and deployment plans after the sale, guide initial configuration and best practices, and make sure customers understand platform capabilities and limitations.

Help customers reach early success milestones to shorten time to value and reduce early friction.

Proactive Technical Guidance

Regularly review customer environments and usage patterns to identify scalability, performance, reliability, security, and compliance risks and opportunities.

Plan upgrades and lifecycle events, and run architecture reviews for upcoming initiatives, including capacity and growth planning, feature readiness, and early identification of technical blockers.

Escalation & Collaboration

Coordinate across Support and Engineering on complex or high-impact issues. TAMs are not frontline support, but provide the context, prioritization, and follow-through that drive resolution, root cause analysis, and preventative action.

Serve as the voice of the customer to Engineering and Product, sharing specific, reproducible feedback on recurring pain points and taking part in beta and early access programs.

Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account health and retention, with technical input on renewals, expansions, and evaluations, and early flags on risks to satisfaction.

Preferred Experience

6+ years of relevant work experience in engineering, SRE, technical consulting, or similar, including operating production systems under real constraints.

Strong technical depth across database internals, scalability, security posture, and infrastructure tradeoffs. You understand a customer’s architecture as well as they do, without escalating every question.

A proactive mindset: you spot risks and optimization opportunities before the customer does, and you treat your accounts like a personal portfolio.

Sound escalation judgment: you know when to escalate, when to resolve internally, and how to communicate clearly under pressure without creating noise.

Very strong communication skills. TAMs explain complex issues to non-technical executives and root causes to senior engineers, often in the same day.

Awareness of how TAM performance shows up in retention and NRR, including surfacing expansion signals and renewal risks early.

Experience working in async or globally distributed teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Scaled Account Manager, Beneficial Deployments
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.

This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.

That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.

What you'll do

  • Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers. Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.

  • Drive activation yourself. Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.

  • Automate your own work. Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.

  • Spend your time on strategic conversations. Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.

  • Spot who is ready for more. Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.

  • Build programs, not one-offs. When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.

  • Be the voice of your book. Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.

Where your time goes as we automate

The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:

  • Deeper with priority accounts. Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.

  • Quarterly launches. Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.

  • Events. Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.

  • New signups and scaled partnerships. Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.

The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology

  • Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around

  • Use AI in your own work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back

  • Bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and can move from a messy situation to a clear plan quickly

  • Have run multi-step programs or projects with several stakeholders and kept them on track

  • Have got things done through people you did not manage, across teams in a larger organization

  • Stay effective when your job changes, and would see automating part of your role as a win

  • Can explain AI plainly to people who are skeptical, busy or new to it

  • Care about the mission of nonprofits and educational institutions, and about AI being developed and deployed safely

Strong candidates may also

  • Have built something from zero, such as a company, a product, a sales motion or a new program, or been an early employee at a startup

  • Have a consulting background, with experience across many sectors and problem types

  • Have worked at an AI-native company or sold AI products, or moved from business development into owning accounts

  • Have worked in or with nonprofits, foundations, Universities or other mission-driven organizations

  • Understand how nonprofits and universities buy, including boards, funders, procurement cycles and tight budgets

  • Have used usage data to prioritize a large book of accounts

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$222,800—$290,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

title: Account Executive (German-Speaking)
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a creative and driven German-Speaking Commercial Account Executive to help grow our customer base of developer-first startups. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in startup environments, enjoys navigating technical sales cycles, and wants to work closely with founders and builders using open source tools.

You’ll manage full-cycle sales, partner cross-functionally to ensure smooth onboarding, and help define what modern sales looks like at Supabase.

You Will:

  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close

  • Run technical discovery and align on business outcomes

  • Partner with Sales Engineers and Product to demo capabilities

  • Educate customers on how Supabase fits into their stack

  • Build pipeline and consistently hit revenue targets

We’re Looking For:

  • 2-5 years experience in a similar technical sales role

  • Strong understanding of developer workflows or infrastructure products

  • Ability to run a creative, value-driven sales process

  • Comfortable talking to founders, engineers, and technical buyers

  • Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

  • Business-Level German

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
